# OnCall Dental Urgent Care

> Emergency dental care provider in Tempe, AZ offering urgent care dentistry, emergency extractions, and cosmetic services with advanced Solea Laser technology.

OnCall Dental Urgent Care specializes in emergency dentistry and urgent care dental services across the Phoenix metropolitan area including Tempe, Chandler, Scottsdale, Gilbert, Peoria, and Surprise, Arizona. The practice emphasizes rapid access to dental care for patients experiencing dental emergencies and offers new patient promotions alongside comprehensive preventative and cosmetic dental services.
